subject: P04-11 generated-profile column-layout reader tests
reviewer_scope: Reviewer did not author adapter tests or adapter implementation. Full test file read and expectations assessed against actual loader/readFile and approved projection contracts; no compiler/native/test execution.

checks.detail: Every fixture begins at mkdtemp /tmp/biglybtc-column-layout-view-tests-XXXXXX, creates private profile children, writes exclusively nofollow and fsyncs actual generated bytes. Symlink/FIFO/directory targets and sentinel paths stay inside that owned root. Cleanup releases its optional lease and unlinks/rmdirs only recorded exact paths, without following symlinks or scanning directories.

Eight selected-candidate cases reflect exact valid-primary, missing-primary saving-before-backup and malformed-primary backup-before-saving order. Seven InvalidFormat cases explicitly cover absent primary with malformed recovery, empty/nonmap/trailing-byte primary. Missing and loaded-empty/absent-table snapshots are independently asserted; per-pane defaults and wrong selected facts remain loaded.

All nine active unsafe candidate positions and three ignored unsafe recovery cases use actual nofollow file reads, not provider substitutions. Regular hardlink acceptance reflects existing read-only data-file policy, distinct from stricter owned single-link profile lock. No test expects a new unsupported ownership restriction.

Before/after lstat+raw bytes/symlink-target snapshots cover exact config candidates, lock, sentinel and owned directories/root. Device/inode/mode/uid/gid/nlink/size/mtime/ctime are compared; atime is deliberately excluded. No save/recovery-created file or metadata mutation is permitted by expectations. Explicit held descriptor invariance is exercised, with stronger pre-call captures in named/recovery cases.

Fixed-size fixtures reach 4MiB exactly and +1, cumulative node fixtures count root+key+list+integer leaves, and empty nested-list depth fixtures have deepest list at root-zero depth64/+1. Each +1 fixture is independently accepted by unchanged generic ConfigFile default limits before expecting ordinary adapter InvalidFormat. Four valid raw documents exceed column/sort/ID/issue projection limits and expect Unsupported; 410 columns × ten wrong slots produce 4100 issues, over4096.

The target-private GNU read wrapper calls __real_read first. It only inspects positive reads by exact fstat device+inode and requests stop on the actual test source; it does not substitute bytes, truncate reads, fabricate errors or change production reader calls. Thread-local arm scopes are synchronous/RAII. Pre-cancel expects zero read calls; selected primary/backup/saving cancellation, whole-loader cancellation and second matched malformed-backup absence-confirmation read all discard state as Cancelled.

Retained snapshots are checked after explicit candidate rename/replacement, independent fresh read, copying, lease release and owned fixture destruction. Raw bytes and old requested width stay stable, while the new snapshot reflects replacement width. This meaningfully exercises no retained fd/lease/caller-tree dependency.

portability_and_limits: Linux/POSIX fixture APIs and GNU-compatible linker --wrap=read are intentional. Register wrapper option only on this test target and link the real profile/core/reader libraries; no production target flag or public test hook is needed.
ReadFile is synchronous; post-real-read cancellation assertions do not promise interruption while ConfigFile::load continues recovery reads/parsing.

The nonallowlisted-source test observes no sentinel read and a missing result; by itself it does not trace every attempted open. The production fixed-name source review supplies that separate restriction.
Fixture cleanup is bounded best effort, not a crash-consistency or arbitrary allocator-exhaustion guarantee. No forced OOM, parser corruption, Java manager or live profile is involved.
No effective Java registered-layout/UI/writer behavior or original Java runtime equality is claimed. Actual native case/assertion totals remain parent-owned execution evidence.
mutations: Only this new original-workspace review JSON was written; frozen tests/production and all profiles were unchanged.
